constraints.name: distinct_points
constraints.description: All points in the beatmap are distinct.

constraints.name: consecutive_triple_acute_angle
constraints.description: For any three consecutive points in the permutation, the angle centered at the middle point must be strictly less than 90 degrees.

constraints.name: permutation_output
constraints.description: The output must be a permutation of integers from 1 to n.
constraints.formal: p is a permutation of {1, …, n}
